description: This file contains unit tests for the ReferralOrderValidator class within the OpenMRS project, specifically testing validation logic related to ReferralOrder objects. It uses JUnit 5 for testing assertions and mocks interactions with core services like ConceptService and OrderService.

classes.name: ReferralOrderValidatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class verifying the behavior of ReferralOrderValidator, especially validation of specimen sources in ReferralOrder objects within the OpenMRS platform.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfTheSpecimenSourceIsInvalid
methods.description: Tests that the validator correctly flags an error when the specimen source concept is not among allowed concepts.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfTheSpecimenSourceIsValid
methods.description: Tests that the validator passes when the specimen source concept is valid and within allowed concepts.
